title: Generated-JSON narrow patch recovery
failure_signature: A multi-file patch assumed generated JSON key order and failed exact-context verification before changing any file.
trigger_preconditions: A generated JSON artifact uses deterministic sorted keys.
The proposed patch context was inferred rather than read from the current file.
candidate_workaround: Read the exact bounded current snippet, patch source-of-truth code first, then patch or regenerate the artifact with minimal exact context.
recurrence_guard: Inspect generated key order before patching and avoid broad multi-file contexts that depend on inferred serialization order.
rollback: No rollback is needed when apply_patch reports zero changes; retain the failed patch witness.
scope_boundary: Owned x1 source and generated JSON only; no destructive rewrite.
